name: Swanath Scholarship Scheme
benefit: Eligible students at the diploma or graduation level will receive financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an orphan, have lost one or both parents due to COVID-19, or be a dependent of a martyr from the military or central armed forces. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
